# reading-room-map

## Start here

1. Read the catalogue card and its recorded shelf mark.

## When to use this skill

- An operator needs the label for a catalogue transfer.

## When NOT to use this skill

- The operator asks for a new acquisition decision.

## Overview

The catalogue desk uses the primary shelf mark to direct transfers between reading rooms. Keep the catalogue number exactly as printed.
